notes.title: Major Update Released!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34818542/dbff5e46cc8713d02b6583b0f5e748b60c440402.jpg
Patch Notes:

 New Mode : Watchtowers added
    Dev Notes: This mode is currently one of the more complex ones. A lot of is going on. You must capture the Guard Towers, keep an eye on exploding barrels and also watch out to not kill yourself or your own gang-members. At first the mode seems a bit chaotic, however after few rounds you will find out it has quite a deep meta gameplay.

 Added more 6 more convict skins 
Dev Notes: More skins means that when player identifies convict of the other player, he has an easier time to keep track of him. This might or might not be a desirable for each mode. We will add a toggle on/off setting for each mode in next update, so players can decide if they want only one skin or all of them in the gameplay. 

 AI convicts should not longer get stuck 




Watchtowers Mode Description:
At start, the prison is divided into coloured gangs, each gang has the same amount of convicts. Unarmed convicts. The goal is to exterminate enemy gang so no members from opposing gangs are left alive. How to kill em when you are unarmed?

Here is how! Each player is in control of one the convict from his gang. He can then capture the guard towers which grants a sniper to a given player. These sniper rifles eye-sights are moving at random so players has no control over them....well you can SHOOT! So be care-full to not shoot you own gang-member! Friendly fire is on ! :D
Also there are some explosive barrels in the prison. You can capture them as well and explode them at will. Again be care-full, these are causing some uncontrollable havoc :D

ENJOY!

Enjoy the new update and let us know if you find any bugs or issues! Also we would be glad for any ideas on a new game modes/features you would like to see in the game!
